title: Boot Architecture: Eager Hydration vs Resumability
description: Compare eager full-tree JS hydration on load against serialized HTML state with lazy interaction-time execution.

before.label: Eager Hydration (O(N) Boot on Load)
before.previewNote: Creates the 'uncanny valley': buttons look clickable before hydration finishes.

after.label: Resumability (O(1) Boot, Lazy Handler)
after.code:
<!-- 1KB global listener delegates click; chunk loads only on tap -->
<button on:click="./chunk-cart.js#addItem" q:state="12">Add</button>
<script type="qwik/json">{"12":{"count":0}}</script>
after.previewNote: Execution resumes at the exact interaction point without replaying SSR.
